[[Rotscale]] is a mighty reanimated dragon from the [[Shiverpeak Mountains]], near [[the Frost Gate (landmark)|the Frost Gate]] and recently made a trek to [[Kryta]], where many adventurers attempted to slay it. Eventually, Rotscale reached the border of the [[Maguuma Jungle]], in [[Majesty's Rest]], where it currently resides with its small but powerful undead army, including several [[Rotting Dragon]]s. Rumors claim that Rotscale guards treasure, supposedly a weapon of value.

== Notes ==
* Unlike other [[zombie]]s, it does not take double damage from [[holy damage]].
* Rotscale has 17700 [[health]] in Hard Mode. It's accompanied by two [[Damned Cleric]]s, a [[Necrid Horseman]], four [[Rotting Dragon]]s, and three [[Skeleton Bowmaster]]s.
* Five [[Smoke Phantom]]s [[popup]] at the bridge leading to Rotscale while fighting Rotscale and its group.
* Certain areas past the bridge around Rotscale periodically inflicts [[poison]] on party members and allies.
* You can pay for two [[buff]]s after summoning a [[Champion of Balthazar]] at the [[statue of Balthazar]] near the bridge to Rotscale:
** [[Morale Boost]] for {{cost|100}}: the usual +2% Morale Boost.
** [[Holy Blessing]] for {{cost|50}}: +25 maximum health and +3 health regeneration.
* While Rotscale can be killed during [[A Vengeance of Blades]], doing so will not complete the related [[Zaishen Bounty]].
* Rotscale is one of the few non-[[boss]] creatures that [[drop]]s a [[Rotwing Recurve Bow|unique weapon]]. Because it is not a boss, you cannot use a [[Signet of Capture]] on it.

== Trivia ==
* [[The Scribe/20060713|Rotscale's Army Increasing in Majesty's Rest]], by [[the Scribe]].
* There used to be a boss called Rotscale in [[Sanctum Cay]]. This boss has since been renamed to simply ''"[[Bone Dragon (boss)|Bone Dragon]]"'' to prevent confusion.
* Rotscale is one of the oldest creatures in the game; it was in the early [[beta]]s in 2004, where there was [[Slay Rotscale|a quest]] and [[Stone Summit (mission)|a mission]] (both removed) using [[The Frost Gate]] mission area in which players had to kill it. During this event, Rotscale had a boss aura unlike later renditions.<ref>[https://photics.com/issues/issue06.pdf Photics issue 06], June 2004</ref>
** It was also used as part of the finale of November 2004 [[Beta Weekend Event]], where many level 21 Rotscales were spawned in [[Lion's Arch]] to kill players.
* Prior to June 15th, 2006, Rotscale was a [[monk]] accompanied by four [[Bone Dragon]]s.
